blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra blew out Rain or Shine from the onset to take a crucial 129-111 win amid the tight Group B quarterfinal race in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. RJ Abarrientos, new import Jordan Murphy and Stephen Holt were among the protagonists in the victory that enabled the Gin Kings to climb in the standings after a sluggish run before the season-ending conference went on hiatus. Abarrientos fired 34 points spiked by six triples; Murphy debuted with 30 points, 13 rebounds, seven assists and four blocks and Holt had 14 points on four triples as Ginebra […]...
